input.content: You are a senior PLC control systems architect. Return ONLY valid JSON.

You are a PLC control software architect. Produce a concise architecture plan (at most 2000 words). Do not enumerate exhaustive traces. Return complete JSON with keys:
- state_machine: list of states and transitions
- timer_plan: timers required, PT durations, reset conditions
- priorities: safety and operational priorities
- initial_values: initial values for variables
- scan_execution_order: explicit 4-stage scan order (1. edge sampling, 2. safety/reset priority & state transitions, 3. unconditional top-level timer FB calls outside CASE/IF, 4. unified output assignments)
- formal_assertions: optional list of {"id": "A1", "formula": "G(...)"} temporal/invariant assertions over declared VAR_INPUT/VAR_OUTPUT port names

SPECIFICATIONS:
{
  "id": "SELF001",
  "title": "Guarded motor with retained run command",
  "difficulty": "easy",
  "requirements": "# SELF001: Guarded Motor Latch\n\n## Background\nTeaching controller for a guarded single-motor latch (not a safety-rated circuit).\n\n## Functional Requirements\n1. Inputs: `Start`, `Stop`, and `GuardClosed` (`BOOL`, all level-sensitive).\n2. On every scan, if `Stop = TRUE` or `GuardClosed = FALSE`, force `Run := FALSE`.\n3. Otherwise, if `Start = TRUE`, set `Run := TRUE` (including when `Start` stays TRUE on the scan `GuardClosed` closes).\n4. Otherwise retain the previous `Run` state.\n\n## Interface\n- **Inputs:** `Start: BOOL`, `Stop: BOOL`, `GuardClosed: BOOL`\n- **Outputs:** `Run: BOOL`\n\n## Initial Values\n- `Run=false`\n\n## Timing & Evaluation Conventions\nSignals are sampled every scan (`dt_ms` is unused for logical transitions).",
  "scenario": "A packaging motor uses a door guard as a scan-level permissive and a retained operator run request.",
  "interface": [
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Start",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Operator start request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "Stop",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Stop request"
    },
    {
      "direction": "INPUT",
      "name": "GuardClosed",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Door permissive"
    },
    {
      "direction": "OUTPUT",
      "name": "Run",
      "type": "BOOL",
      "description": "Motor run command"
    }
  ],
  "initial_conditions": {
    "Run": false
  },
  "scan_semantics": "At scan k, sample every input once, read retained pre-state q[k], execute one transition, and observe outputs O[k] at the end of that same scan. Updated state becomes q[k+1]. Reset the instance before each test. Step 0 executes normally; initial conditions describe pre-state, not an extra delayed scan. All timing in this task is explicitly counted in invocations, not wall time.",
  "safety_priority": [
    "Open guard and Stop override Start",
    "Loss of permissive clears the retained latch"
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "Inputs are level-sensitive; no start edge is required.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.",
    "The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values."
  ],
  "atomic_propositions": {
    "Start": "I[k].Start: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Stop": "I[k].Stop: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "GuardClosed": "I[k].GuardClosed: sampled input (BOOL).",
    "Run": "O[k].Run: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.",
    "first": "k=0; first invocation, not the pre-invocation observation",
    "qRun": "{\"kind\": \"previous_observed_output\", \"source\": \"O[k-1].Run\", \"initial\": false, \"update\": \"After comparing scan k, store ACTUAL O[k].Run; never write into reference state.\"}",
    "init": "At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: O_init.Run=false."
  },
  "ltl": [
    {
      "id": "SELF001.P_init",
      "kind": "safety",
      "formula": "init",
      "description": "Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.",
      "explanation": "Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "INITIAL_INSTANCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF001.P1",
      "formula": "G(first -> !qRun)",
      "explanation": "The instance starts with no retained run request.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF001.P2",
      "formula": "G((Stop | !GuardClosed) -> !Run)",
      "explanation": "Stop and guard override every startup request in the same scan.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF001.P3",
      "formula": "G((Start & !Stop & GuardClosed) -> Run)",
      "explanation": "A permitted start takes effect at end of the sampled scan.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF001.P4",
      "formula": "G((!Start & !Stop & GuardClosed) -> (Run <-> qRun))",
      "explanation": "Retain the preceding run value without a new command.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    },
    {
      "id": "SELF001.P5",
      "formula": "G(Run -> X(Stop | !GuardClosed | Run))",
      "explanation": "Across invocations, run persists unless a higher-priority input intervenes.",
      "language": "LTL_OVER_TYPED_SCAN_PREDICATES",
      "encoding_status": "NOT_LOWERED_TO_MODEL_CHECKER",
      "scope": "SCAN_SEQUENCE"
    }
  ]
}
